turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyText:
Standard domestic and international orders can take up to **4 business days** to process before they ship and tracking starts updating.

Once a tracking number is issued, the first carrier scan can sometimes take a couple of days to show. For shipping timeframes by method, see [Shipping Options](https://www.fashionnova.com/pages/shipping-options).

turns.q: Once it ships, how long is delivery?
turns.replyText:
It depends on the shipping method you choose at checkout:

- **Standard Shipping:** 3–7 business days  
- **2 Business Days (order by 3pm ET):** 2 business days  
- **1 Business Day (order by 3pm ET):** 1 business day  
- **UPS Saturday Delivery:** Saturday arrival (when available at checkout)  
- **Same Day Delivery (LA only, order by 12pm PT):** same day  

Business days don’t include weekends or US holidays. More details: [Shipping Options](https://www.fashionnova.com/pages/shipping-options).

turns.q: Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?
turns.replyText:
Once an order is placed, the shipping method can’t be changed.

If you need it sooner, the only way is to place a new order and choose an expedited option at checkout (like 1 Business Day or 2 Business Days) if it’s available for your address.

turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
turns.replyText:
If tracking never updates, it usually means either the carrier hasn’t done the first scan yet (that can take a couple of days after a tracking number is issued) or the order is still processing (processing can take up to 4 business days).

If it’s past the estimated delivery date and tracking still hasn’t moved, contact us and we can investigate. You can also check status here: [track your order](https://www.fashionnova.com/pages/track-order).

turns.q: How do I find my tracking link?
turns.replyText:
You can find it in 2 places:

- Your shipping confirmation email (it includes the tracking link and tracking number).
- Your Fashion Nova account: **Account > Orders**, then open the order to view the tracking link.

You can also use the self-serve page here: [track your order](https://www.fashionnova.com/pages/track-order).
